title: IncidentResponseInput
description: Schema definition and real-world sample input for the Incident Response Room system.

scenario.description: Identifier of the incident type or failure scenario.

raw_logs.description: Raw unparsed text log stream from stdout/stderr of affected service containers.

auto_approve.description: If true, bypasses interactive human approval for MEDIUM risk fixes (automated test mode).

metadata.description: Optional infrastructure context accompanying the incident.
